<div style="height:45px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:20px">Our fiscal rules are non-negotiable and will apply to every decision taken by a Labour government. This means that the current budget must move into balance, so that day-to-day costs are met by revenues and debt must be falling as a share of the economy by the fifth year of the forecast.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:20px">Costs for Labourâs additional public services spending are set out below. We have used the last year of the most recent Office for Budget Responsibility forecast (2028-29) which represents the highest annual cost of the policies. <p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:20px">We have not allocated all additional revenue to potential spending. This is a prudent approach in line with our commitment to economic stability.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:20px">Policies not listed here will be funded from existing budgets or do not have a cost.</p>
